# aaam.dev

> A small independent app studio making quiet, private, ad-free apps. Two apps are live, both free with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no tracking: **hum** (a private home for couples) and **tir** (a live semantic word race).

aaam.dev was established May 2026. Both apps are available free on the Apple App Store and as Android builds. The studio's whole premise is software that respects users: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no signup walls, no tracking.

## Apps

- [tir — word race](https://aaam.dev/tir/): A fast-twitch live word game. A target word appears; players race to reach it by picking the option closest in meaning (semantic, not spelling). First to the target wins. One always-on global room with real opponents and pure pairwise Elo ranking (the same math chess uses). Free on iOS and Android. No ads, no in-app purchases, no signup. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tir-word-race/id6768131124
- [hum — for two](https://aaam.dev/hum/): A calm, invite-only home for couples. Log mood, track shared habits, decide together, give awards, and trade reasons you love each other. Private to two linked people — no feed, no ads, no subscriptions, no tracking. Free on iOS and Android. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hum-for-two/id6768805132
